sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You must learn to get to the root of a routine to keep things fresh today, feels Ganesha. Just learn the basic psychology of people and analyse the facts. All action and decision has a motive, you will need to understand the chain to get the most out of things, advises Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Today you might hear of opportunities to make extra money through creative work of some kind, Taurus. This could be a genuine lucky break achieved by being in the right place at the right time. You will probably take advantage of it, because right now you're full of inspiration. You might have a hard time keeping track of all your ideas. Write them down!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: The universe holds you to high standards this morning, dearest Taurus, as the Capricorn Moon and Saturn align. Follow through on any promises you've made to yourself or your higher power, especially if related wishes have already manifested. Expand upon existing success to go further, acknowledging the vital role discipline and practicality play in this process. Be mindful of who or what has been throwing your thoughts out of balance as Mercury ends its retrograde journey. Luckily, you'll have a chance to establish healthier dynamics and communication practices as Venus stations direct this evening.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Don't depend on fate try to improve your health as fortunate is a lazy goddess Those who were going through financial crisis for a long time can attain money from anywhere today, which will eliminate several life problems in an instant. You need to be patient with children or those who are less experienced than you are. You needn't dream about your erotic fantasies anymore; they might come true today. Exercise caution- wisdom and patience while dealing with people at work. Dedicate your time and energy in helping others- but don't get involved in matters that doesn't concern you at all.
